subject: reasoning
question: A person walks 6 km north, then 8 km east, and finally 6 km south. What is the shortest distance between his starting point and ending point?
solution:
6 km north and 6 km south cancel each other

⇒ Net vertical displacement = 0

Horizontal displacement

⇒ 8 km east

⇒ Shortest distance = 8 km

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/073e3757330340404597237485d422d56724b695aa7d894880965d9595c67d3d.png] 

∴ The shortest distance between starting and ending point is 8 km.
